description: Execute Python using Python 3. Provide inline Python or a script path; the tool runs it with the configured Python executable and returns stdout, stderr, exit code, and execution status.

inlineScript.description: Python source code to execute with Python 3. Use this or scriptPath.
inlineScript.name: inlineScript

pythonExecutable.description: Optional absolute path to the Python executable, or 'python3' to resolve via /usr/bin/env.
pythonExecutable.name: pythonExecutable

resultMode.description: Result handling mode. Use 'capture' to return stdout/stderr automatically, or 'toolResultJSON' to parse stdout as a complete MCP tool result JSON object.
resultMode.name: resultMode

scriptArguments.description: Arguments passed to the Python script.
scriptArguments.name: scriptArguments

scriptPath.description: Absolute path to a Python file to execute. Use this or inlineScript.
scriptPath.name: scriptPath

stdin.description: Optional text passed to the Python process via stdin.
stdin.name: stdin

stdinJSON.description: Optional JSON object passed to the Python process via stdin.
stdinJSON.name: stdinJSON

timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum execution time in seconds. Defaults to 60 and is capped by the plugin.
timeoutSeconds.name: timeoutSeconds

workingDirectory.description: Optional working directory for the Python process.
workingDirectory.name: workingDirectory

name: python_runtime

launchError.description: Launch error details if the Python process could not be started.
launchError.name: launchError

pythonExecutable.description: Resolved Python executable used for execution.
pythonExecutable.name: pythonExecutable

resultMode.description: Result handling mode used by the tool.
resultMode.name: resultMode

scriptPath.description: Python file path used for execution, if any.
scriptPath.name: scriptPath

stderr.description: Captured stderr from the Python process.
stderr.name: stderr

stdout.description: Captured stdout from the Python process.
stdout.name: stdout

success.description: Whether the Python process exited successfully.
success.name: success

workingDirectory.description: Working directory used by the Python process.
workingDirectory.name: workingDirectory
